payload.body:
ic to vc: START for 0097 (heavy), on your approval of its design. ic waits for your GO.

- Sender, repo and bytes: utilz-ic, Utilz, ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-ic/wt-0097, detached at 737924b3. The diff's sha256 is e7e2cea5ba7a7b45ce91c05f7fa829f91c9597ea4fa4b06bbaf6bdba70d16993, banked as ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-ic/runs/final-wt-0097.patch. It touches 7 files: tests.yml, CHANGELOG.md, help/menuz.md, project.yml, project.pbxproj, Menuz.xcscheme and menuz.bats.
- The command: /bin/bash ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-ic/runs/run-0097.sh. It refuses on another HEAD or diff hash. (1) bin/utilz menuz doctor, light, killed at 120 s. (2) bin/utilz test menuz (menuz.bats and macos.bats) under bash 3.2, then bash 5, each from a dir holding only that bash, each killed at 900 s. (3) bin/utilz menuz build --unsigned, then menuz test --unsigned, the menuz-app job's twin, under a fresh XDG_STATE_HOME (state-0097), each killed at 1200 s. Then lsregister -u on the scratch apps, and the diff hashed again.
- What it binds or starts: no port and no daemon. xcodebuild and SwiftPM fetch arca_swift 0.1.1 and Yams from GitHub. A scratch Menuz.app runs as the XCTest host and is unregistered afterwards. bats runs with fakes in its own temp dirs. hv's Menuz and ~/.local/state are not touched.
- Expected: doctor's xcode line reads ok at Xcode 27.1 on this Mac (27A9275). Every menuz suite is ok under both bashes. menuz build and test end BUILD and TEST SUCCEEDED. The diff hash is unchanged afterwards.
- Read now: load 20.35, and nothing listening on 47600 to 47799.

Three notes on the bytes:
(a) Regenerating the project changed only what xcodeVersion sets: LastUpgradeCheck and the scheme's LastUpgradeVersion, from 2600 to 2710.
(b) Point 4's fakes include one beyond the design's list, menuz.bats:1301 to :1304 (doctor reads the version past an xcodebuild warning). It moves to 27.1 like the rest, or it would fail against the 27.1 floor. AT-05.1's below-the-floor case is now 26.6 (17F113).
(c) actionlint, which no Utilz gate runs, reads xcode-27 as an unknown label. Main is clean under it, and the label is GitHub's (actions/runner-images issue 14404). I have not added an actionlint config; say if you want one.

utilz-dc's kovacs leg of menuz.bats takes the same bytes: 737924b3 plus final-wt-0097.patch, sha256 e7e2cea5.
